verdict.rationale: Kommo is a CRM SaaS platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. However, the evidence covers only a CRM API, a Web SDK, webhooks, an llms.txt file and markdown docs, and none of it mentions an official command-line tool. API and SDK building blocks do not count as a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
